name: personal-context-extension
description: Browser extension that captures AI chat sessions into Personal Context

scripts.dev: echo 'Build in watch mode: use esbuild --watch' && esbuild src/content.js --bundle --outfile=content.js --watch
scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && cp manifest.json dist/ && cp -r popup sidepanel providers lib icons dist/ && echo 'Build complete'
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../personal-context-extension.zip .
